rationale: The original long thesis has degraded as price has recorded five consecutive 1-minute lower highs and lower closes, slipping below the 5-minute 9-EMA ($43.33) after failing to hold initial gains (+0.92% MFE). Furthermore, the broader market has weakened further since entry (SPY down from -0.90% to -1.08%), increasing downside drag. Closing now preserves capital ahead of the $42.95 invalidation level rather than absorbing a full stop-out in a deteriorating structure.
